title: Prove the native P104 channel's all-cut precision interface
body:
## Result and research claim

This supplies a **finite local precision interface** for the actual native P104 `G/2` channel of [PR1991](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1991), not a new channel compilation, side correction or supplier. The domain is the immutable 4,058-event word: 104 sources, 104 targets, 72 arbitrary dirty helpers and eight distinct owned private-copy lifetimes.

The norm is the maximum of individual register **Hilbert norms**, not an addresswise maximum or a concatenated all-register norm. If each independent input has norm at most `B`, exact signed propagation gives:

| Quantity | Exact coefficient |
|---|---:|
| Maximum ideal input-to-prefix row norm | **106** (the ideal endpoint maximum is only 26) |
| All-cut accumulation of independent unit absolute defects at every update | **450** |
| All-cut weighted accumulation, with addition weight `1+abs(a)` and other update weights 1 | **668** |
| Native-child-only all-cut accumulation | **356**, versus final all-role coefficient **336** |

The absolute-defect statement is sharp for independent arbitrary additive vector defects. There are 4,042 defect sites: 1,410 native transports, 2,624 scalar additions and eight copies. Exact-zero allocation, exact monomial factors and owned discard are explicit premises. Final all-defect coefficients are 7 for sources, 1153/4 for targets and 450 for dirty helpers. Discarding a private copy does not erase errors already propagated to other registers.

For state-relative local defects bounded by `u` times the actual input norm at a native transport/copy, or `u*(||dst||+abs(a)*||src||)` at an addition, the complete all-cut feedback implication is

```
668*u < 1
M <= 106*B/(1-668*u)
max_boundary_error <= 106*668*u*B/(1-668*u).
```

Thus **`u <= 2^(-b-17)` suffices** for all-role error at most `B*2^-b`, for every integer `b>=0`. The feedback estimate is sufficient, not an attained rounding error or a minimal-precision claim. In particular, neither endpoint-only accuracy nor exact symbolic dirty restoration can replace all-cut stability.

## Proof-critical native binding and method

The retained primitive is `C_q=((1+i)I+(1-i)X_q)/2`, with eigenvalues `1` and `i` on the two eigenspaces of the involutive permutation `X_q`. Its inverse and every address-permutation/Gaussian-phase factor are unitary. The replay authenticates source bytes **before importing** the retained independent interpreter, then checks all **740 transport recipes / 1,410 occurrences**, **208 monomial endpoint adapters** and **948 exact normalized Gaussian columns**, including signed Pauli actions and scalar phases. It does not assume an unspecified recursive child is contractive.

A physical defect after an instruction is conjugated by that instruction's actual unitary canonical frame. Its Hilbert norm is unchanged, leaving the exact literal scalar recurrence. Forward input/error-symbol rows cover every instruction boundary; a separate reverse-adjoint recurrence agrees on all **62,867 nonzero signed endpoint-response coefficients** and the entire arbitrary-input map. Sign-aligned constructive executions attain 106, 450 and the independent weighted-defect coefficient 668. Exact native controls distinguish Hilbert from pointwise norms and show that norm bounds alone cannot authenticate global phase.

## Accounting and limitations

The word and paid profile are unchanged:

`1074 H1 + 58 H2 + 86 H3 + 104 H4 + 48 H5 + 24 H6 + 8 H7 + 8 H8`, rank mass **2368 = 2312 boundary coverage + COPY56**.

No precision reserve or recursive charge is removed. The abstract argument applies to the same scalar word with unitary charts in any Hilbert dimension, but only the concrete nine-coordinate/512-address native realization is source-checked. This does **not** establish actual rounded-child error bounds, internal recursive-kernel stability, the `I-G/2` correction, chronological global owner hosting, tape/all-size admission, a completed supplier moment or a new κ. The selected frontier and frozen predecessors are untouched.

## Evidence and reproduction

Eight files, all under `research/p104-native-precision/`, including proof, full selection/task/source/replay metadata, exact receipt and semantic tests.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-native-precision
```

Observed locally on CPython 3.12/macOS arm64; the complete registered replay also passed a separate AI-assisted review/replay before publication:

```text
PASS_P104_NATIVE_PRECISION input=106 absolute=450 relative=668 guard_bits=17 native_recipes=740 endpoint_coefficients=62867 controls=13 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_NATIVE_PRECISION_TESTS dense_defects=4042 independent_impulses=18 source_drift=reject read_only_optimized_export=pass
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-native-precision outcome=completed
```

The 13 controls include constructive sharpness, endpoint/interior distinctions, dirty-restoration defects, surviving private-copy errors, missing compensation/cleanup, private-lifetime aliasing, native normalization, wrong norm, phase blindness and the relative-feedback guard. The additional execution uses all 4,042 rational defects and 18 individual impulses spanning every native rank and private lifetime. A changed interpreter is rejected before execution; an optimized read-only relocated export preserves all bytes. Default replay compares canonical payloads and writes nothing. No selected cold replay, proof-assistant run or hosted CI pass is claimed.

## Provenance, predecessors and scope change

- Scientific base: `564148b82ae9df72163f22106f15e73efca8aff2`; contribution commit: `f22626f334a06f6e842766e4a6647419e6821d2d`.
- Independent sole chooser seed: `1be10fd8d275206692a433be1dacd810`, complex-mechanisms, priority revision 4. The P104 card is explicitly **changed** from correction construction to this separate local precision obligation left open by PR1991; no claim to passing its supplier-construction gate.
- [PR1972](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1972), `fd82d172f46933fd253c2c6de4bd5eaff5429cfd`, supplies the entire scalar/frame channel. PR1991, reviewed at `6e222517e182e98499239bc9a4009f540e1c5520`, supplies its concrete native realization.
- [PR2067](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2067) concerns an all-size endpoint recurrence for complete PR628 balanced-word leaves, a different word and error domain. The selected1094 wire-prefix and dirty-prefix monomial audits are credited norm-method precedents, not transplanted constants.
- Active terminal correction work in [Discussion2080](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2080) is separate and is neither consumed nor certified here.
- The inspected canonical checkpoint `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` changes guidance only; catalogue/scientific inputs are unchanged. Final targeted offline overlap used the shared complete snapshot of 353 open PRs and 738 discussion/comment/reply records, plus local and targeted live predecessor reading. Coverage and exact timestamps are recorded in TASK; absence of matches is not a novelty guarantee.

Credit Rohan Arun/PR1972, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR1991, Adam Gall/PR1940, Josie Elliston/PR1071, Ali Romman/PR1125 and PR1862/1931, icekylinx's Clifford lineage, and the retained E8/dirty-helper predecessors. Source-specific notices remain unchanged. New material is Apache-2.0. Prepared by Adam Gall with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof, implementation, verification and writing; review was also AI-assisted, not independent human or formal review.

## Open next questions

1. Bind an actual rounded recursive child to the completed-output Hilbert-norm defect contract at the P104 ranks; native unitarity alone does not supply this implementation premise.
2. Once a corrected chronological P104 word is available, recompute the **combined** prefix and defect maps, rather than composing only endpoint error constants.
3. Propagate actual owner-family magnitudes and nonzero helper residual errors through globally hosted corrected calls, retaining all precision/tape/all-size charges.
